book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: ISBABEL CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY CORINTO

content: Chꞌen colwal chialaxto tet ebnaj ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo
Wal chꞌen heyofrenda chicutxi texol, chꞌen chialaxto tet mac ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, checutxbawe chꞌen hacaꞌ yu walnihan tet ebnaj juẍta ay yul ismajul Galacia.

Hunun domingo yin̈ semana, yilal hepohnilo hanicꞌo chꞌen melyu cheyikꞌ yin̈ hemunil hununex, hataticꞌa hanta chicolwa Comam teyin̈, cat hecꞌubantoj, haxinwal yet chinapnihan matxa yilalo chꞌah chꞌen texol.
Hato yet chinapnihan texol cat wanitojan mac saybilxa heyu, cat yinito ebnaj hunu carta yeb chꞌen hecolwal tuꞌ tet ebnaj juẍtaj ay bey Jerusalén.
Yajaꞌ ta han-caw-inan chintohan xin, yilalticꞌa chitopaxo ebnaj wintajan.
Yalto naj Pablo tato chiapni naj yilaꞌ macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam bey Corinto
Hayet chintohan yin̈ inbeltuꞌan yilal wecꞌan bey Macedonia, lahwi tuꞌ xin cat wapnihan quexwilnojan bey Corinto tuꞌ.
Etzan̈em chincanan hanicꞌo tiempohal tecꞌatan̈, maca xin haꞌ bey tuꞌ ayinicꞌojan chiecꞌ n̈abil; ta hac tuꞌ hexxa chexcolwa win̈an yin̈ inbelan yet chinelan texol.
Mach chiwochehan tato yin̈ an̈e chinecꞌan quexwilaꞌan, wal xin chiwochehan chincanan hanicꞌo tiempohal texol, ta hac tuꞌ chiel yin̈ iscꞌul Comam Dios.
Yajaꞌ xin yilalto incanan bey Efeso tiꞌ masanto yet chiecꞌ kꞌin̈ pentecostés.
Yuto caw chalte isba munil yin̈ ismunil Comam Dios chiwilan, yuxin chincanan waxan̈ca xin caw ay mac ayco ishowal win̈an.
Ta chiapni naj Timoteo tecꞌatan̈ xahan cheyil naj, haxinwal chitzala iscꞌul naj texol, yuto chimunlapaxo naj yin̈ ismunil Comam Dios hacaꞌ intiꞌan.
Tajca mach chicam hecꞌul yin̈ naj, wal xin colwahan̈we yin̈ naj haxinwal chislah naj isbel yin̈ tzalahilal cat yul naj cocꞌatan̈an̈, yuto chijechmahan̈ naj yeb ebnaj juẍtaj.
Wal naj juẍta Apolos, walan tet naj tato chito naj yinta ebnaj to quexilnoj, yajaꞌ machisjeto naj. Yettojab hunelxa chito naj yet ay ishamanil naj.
Yet istakꞌlito naj Pablo tet macta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam bey Corinto
Hex wuẍtaj, hex wanab, caw majwahan̈wej, lin̈bawe heba yin̈ huneꞌ bay ayxaco heyanma, caw mach chexxiwi, akꞌwe yip heyanma.
Sunilojab tzet chewatxꞌe, ayojab iscꞌulchꞌanil hecꞌul yin̈.

Hex wuẍtaj hex wanab, caw heyohtaj tato naj juẍta Estéfanas yeb yuninal haꞌ babel yaco isba yul iskꞌab Comam Dios bey yul ismajul Acaya tuꞌ. Caw xin huneln̈e yeco yanma naj iscolwa yin̈ mac ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam.
Chiwochehan ta cheyije tet naj Estéfanas yeb yuninal tuꞌ, yeb tet sunil macta chicolwahi yeb chimunla yin̈ ismunil Comam.
Caw chintzalahan yuto hul naj Estéfanas yeb naj Fortunato yebpaxo naj Acaico bey tiꞌ, yuto yet chiwilnihan yin̈ ebnaj hacaꞌojtam hex chiwilicojan teyin̈.
Yin̈ caw yeli ebnaj tiꞌ yakꞌ tzalaho ebnaj incꞌulan, hacaꞌ yu yakꞌni tzalaho ebnaj hecꞌul. Ebnaj juẍta hacaꞌ ebnaj tiꞌ, ayojab yelapno ebnaj yul hesat.

Ebnaj juẍta ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Dios yul hunu con̈ob yul ismajul Asia tiꞌ, chalto ebnaj ta cheyil heba. Hacpax tuꞌ naj juẍta Aquila yeb ix janab Priscila yeb ebnaj juẍta chiscutxba isba yul yatut naj, chalpaxtoj ta cheyil heba.
Hacpax tuꞌ ebnaj juẍta ay bey tiꞌ chalpaxto ebnaj ta cheyil heba. Yeb xin kꞌambewepaxo teyet yin̈ tzalahilal hanicꞌ heye hununex.
Hanin Pablo intiꞌan han-caw-inan chintzꞌibn̈ehan yul carta tiꞌ ta cheyil heba.
Ta ay hunu mac mach chiochen Comam Jesucristo, tijab isyaꞌtajil yiban̈. Yin̈ sunil wanmahan chiwalnihan tet Comam: ¡Mam Jesucristo Jahawilan̈, hulan̈! quinchiyan.
Yakꞌabayo Comam Jesucristo iscꞌulchꞌanil iscꞌul teyiban̈.
Caw chitzala wanmahan teyin̈ hesunil, hex ayexxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo. ¡Hacojab tuꞌ!
